opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions up to £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections up to £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications up to £5,000; Long-Term Research up to £20,000; Research and Travel up to £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (for most categories); individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators for the Research and Travel category. Applications from individuals independently wishing to create, inform, develop or research their own practice are not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research that expands the appreciation of sculpture. Categories: New Projects and Commissions (exhibitions, catalogues, commissions), Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications, Long-Term Research, and Research and Travel grants for individuals. Applications considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation up to £600 (UK), £700 (Europe), £1,000 (rest of world) plus accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for longer six-week Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute's facilities in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications are currently closed for 2026/27; the next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes awarded for outstanding writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. Submissions for the next prize will open in autumn.
